svg.aria-label: RainReady UAE key features infographic: nine feature cards plus verification facts
svg.text: Sovereign Water & HSE Command — key features of the prototype

g.text: Six labels, never merged
observed water · susceptibility · forecast risk
anomaly · suspected incident · confirmed incident
Each with its own provenance. A SAR mask is
"candidate inundation at acquisition time", not "flood".
Ordinal bands only — no uncalibrated probabilities
Versioned hazard tools
Water-balance twin with mass-balance assertion;
flash-flood vs waterlogging mechanisms.
SAR change screen · residual leak screen
asset exposure · constrained router
Numbers come only from tools, never from the planner
Eight bounded personas
Observer · Hydrologist · Utility Engineer · HSE Officer
Response Planner · Comms · Assurance · Coordinator
Typed outputs, tool allowlists, call/time budgets,
max 2 evidence loops → urgent human review.
LangGraph state graph · structured summaries, no chain-of-thought
Human approval, hash-bound
Interrupt-only gate. Approval binds incident version,
proposal version, payload hash, tools, destinations,
approver identity and expiry.
Any edit invalidates it. Re-checked at execution.
Roles from the signed server session only
Ack ≠ action
Simulated dispatch returns a receipt. Acknowledgement
changes nothing physical; only completion applies an
effect and triggers reassessment.
Closure needs a new observation + authorized review.
No valve, power or evacuation endpoint exists
Untrusted text is data
Field reports pass a guard gate: imperative
instructions are quarantined, observations kept,
casualty mentions preserved and escalated.
Scenario D: "dispatch crews now" never becomes an action.
Optional Content Safety / JailbreakDetect adapters (not exercised)
What-if digital twin
Rain multiplier · drain blockage · pump availability
mobile pump · sensor outage · report reliability.
Baseline vs intervention at +30 / +60 / +180 min
(simulation horizons, not forecasts).
Labelled "scenario model — uncalibrated"
Sovereign by configuration
Provider allowlist · no cloud fallback · server-only
secrets · local basemap, no external tiles or CDN.
demo → local_nim → approved_hosted, never silent.
/v1/models discovery, exact id match, validated output.
Real inference not yet exercised (credential rejected, 401)
Assurance built in
Hash-linked audit chain (tamper-evident, not
tamper-proof) · emergency stop · guard-outage rules
· redacted logs · provider status per adapter.
Evaluation harness says "not evaluated" without labels.
EN + Arabic RTL · six views · works offline
Verified: 27 API tests · 3 browser smoke tests (local + hosted) · deployed on Modal (single container, SQLite on volume)
Not claimed: lives saved, losses avoided, accuracy, agency endorsement, exercised model inference.
